# Remote Work Handbook

Effective date: 2026-04-01

## Rules
- Employees must be online during core hours 10:00–15:00 local time.
- Customer data may not leave approved devices.
- Managers must approve equipment purchases above $500.

## Exceptions
Contractors working under a signed DPA may use managed virtual desktops.

## Applicability
This policy applies to full-time employees in Product and Engineering.
